Clash Erupts Over Vegetable Market Eviction in Bhathagaon, Raipur

A significant clash occurred in Bhathagaon, Raipur, when a municipal corporation team arrived to remove a vegetable market. The situation escalated into violence, with locals confronting the team. Reports indicate that a police officer and three other individuals were injured during the altercation. The incident led to tension in the area.
